close_reason: Added NOTE comment in server_stores.rs documenting that TlsrptRecorder is not yet consumed; RFC 8460 report generation deferred
description: MtaStsEnforcer::record_failure() accumulates TLS failure events into the TlsrptRecorder, and the tlsrpt_recorder() getter exposes the Arc. However, build_smtp_relay_queue() in server_stores.rs creates the enforcer and passes it to SmtpRelayQueue but never retrieves the recorder or wires it to any reporting task. Result: RFC 8460 TLSRPT reports are never generated or sent, so policy failures are silently dropped rather than reported to domain owners. The enforcement and recording paths work correctly; the reporting path is entirely absent.
title: TLSRPT recorder accumulated but never sent — RFC 8460 reports never generated
